Objection: The Gospels Were Written Too Late to Trust
ObjectionSummary: The Gospels were written decades after Jesus, so legends had time to grow. We cannot know what really happened.
Response: Decades is actually very early by ancient standards - Alexander's earliest biographies are centuries later, yet historians trust them. The Gospels were written within the lifetime of eyewitnesses, and Paul's letters (within 20 years) already contain the core claims and an early creed dating to within a few years of the crucifixion. Legend needs time and distance; the Gospels had neither.
